other_conditions: Student must be studying in a Government college of Chhattisgarh under the Higher Education Department
Student must not be receiving any other scholarship
Student must pass the annual examination in the first attempt
Student attendance should not be shortened
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹300 per month for UG students and ₹500 per month for PG students, transferred directly to the student's bank account via DBT (Aadhaar‑linked).
